current_scope.purpose: Hash-oriented public ledger for R&D documentation, IPR Base references, IPR Verified public proof references, IPR AI Audit Trail references, evidence-pack continuity and deterministic verification review.
current_scope.public_position: This public ledger is an R&D proof-reference surface. It is not a public authority registry, not a civil identity registry, not a regulated certification register, not an eIDAS qualified trust service, not a regulated KYC/AML provider, not a custodial identity service, and not a production compliance framework by itself.
current_scope.operational_boundary: The ledger exposes only public proof hashes and minimized metadata. It does not expose tax codes, fiscal codes, document numbers, identity documents, identity scans, biometric material, private evidence, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, personal data, client files, credentials, private keys, internal endpoints, financial assets, or confidential payloads.

IPR_BASE.interpretation: Technical R&D record for proof flows and controlled demonstrations. It does not create verified identity status.

IPR_VERIFIED.interpretation: Private verification profile. Tax-code and valid identity-document evidence may be used only in a controlled private layer. The public ledger stores only minimized proof references.

IPR_PROFESSIONAL.interpretation: Future professional or business/audit workflow profile based on IPR Verified. It remains pilot-positioned and does not create regulated certification by itself.

rules.public_hash_interpretation: A present hash means that a public proof reference exists. It does not certify legal validity, cybersecurity assurance, public authority approval, regulated compliance, KYC/AML compliance, eIDAS qualification, institutional mandate, or production authorization.
rules.production_interpretation: R&D and public proof entries must not be interpreted as regulated certification, public authority approval, legal identity certification, KYC/AML compliance, production compliance validity, cybersecurity assurance, or operational authorization unless independently supported by a lawful production framework.

privacy_note: The public ledger must not expose tax codes, fiscal codes, document numbers, identity documents, identity document scans, biometric material, raw personal identifiers, private evidence, credentials, secrets, private keys, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, client files, production logs, internal endpoints, financial assets, regulated identity documents, or sensitive operational payloads. Public hashes should represent minimized public proof commitments, preferably derived from canonical records or private commitments rather than raw personal identifiers.
empty_ledger_interpretation: An empty entries array means no public proof entries are currently available in this ledger file. It does not certify absence of activity, validity, authorization, compliance, cybersecurity assurance, identity status or operational status by itself.

entries.note: Historical public proof retained with generalized privacy-safe label. The entry is hash-oriented and does not expose raw personal-identifier semantics in the public ledger.
